fusions.name: Gorge on the Spoiled
fusions.desc: Bites the first enemy within 3 tiles for 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Clears the Table
fusions.desc: Lets go a reek that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks them back 3 tiles and leaves them [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Roadside Leavings
fusions.desc: Eats from every body within 8 tiles, up to 5; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Belch After Supper
fusions.desc: Each time you gain health, a belch of musk hits the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 6 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
